title: Find the Minimum Number of Fibonacci Numbers Whose Sum Is K
goal: Use the fewest Fibonacci numbers whose sum equals k.
strategy: Choose the greatest Fibonacci value no larger than the remaining target. Repeating on the remainder yields a minimal greedy decomposition.
